risk_note: RV1 contract (S-16, rulings D10-757, D10-763). New planned read-only list GET /admin/v1/product-feedbacks (adminListProductFeedbacks: filters platform, reason, from inclusive / to exclusive with from >= to → 20001 fields [from, to]; AdminPage / AdminPageSize; created_at descending then server-internal order; only the console's app; deleted users' feedback is gone per BR-ID-28; items carry no phone, device identifier or app_id, guest user_id null) and new permission point feedback.view (read only, no step-up, no audit). The frozen permission list gains one entry (precedent CT-24zi). No runtime code, no migration; the implementation is B1-28s. 04 §6.3 / §11.1 are written back by the orchestrator after the merge (D10-763). Full verification by the required CI checks.

reviews.note: Codex's own verdict in rounds 1 and 2 was fail, on one S1 only (contracts/openapi.yaml:28971): SPEC_REF 18f0015e's 04 §6.3 still says the admin view is to be planned and §11.1 has no feedback.view, so the new operation and permission have no planning source yet. Round 2 changed the citation from 04 §11.1 to ruling D10-757; Codex kept the S1 open. S1 由编排 D10-763 裁定关闭，04 §6.3 / §11.1 合并后由编排回写 (a planning writeback gap, not a contract error; D10-757 orders contract first, as CT-24zi did). This entry records the ruling's outcome, not a Codex pass. No other finding on shape, wording or generated files. Static, nothing executed by Codex. couli-runs/CT-26x/review-contract-r1.json, review-contract-r2.json.

The frozen test/spec/admin/permissions/expected.ts gains only feedback.view (precedent CT-24zi).
